question: Should outbound recovery keep no-adapter ambiguous entries pending with backoff after the pacing bug is fixed, instead of moving them to failed?
rationale: Tests can prove either behavior, but choosing recoverable pending versus fail-closed terminalization changes upgrade and operator semantics for existing ambiguous delivery rows.

options.title: Accept Pending Deferral After Repair
options.body: Merge after the no-op pacing bug is fixed and exact-head validation passes, preserving future recoverability for ambiguous rows.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed Until Ledger Design
options.body: Pause or close this PR and keep current terminal failed behavior until the broader delivery-state ledger is designed.

options.title: Require Operator Surfacing First
options.body: Ask for a visible doctor, API, or UI surface before letting ambiguous rows remain pending longer.

recommendation.title: Accept Pending Deferral After Repair
recommendation.body: Merge after the no-op pacing bug is fixed and exact-head validation passes, preserving future recoverability for ambiguous rows.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans core queue semantics, upgrade behavior, and operator visibility, and steipete is the strongest recent routing signal for this surface.
